chart_data_needs.title: Annual Urban Drone Delivery Market Size (Top-Down Sizing)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Is the total addressable market for urban drone deliveries large enough to justify a $45.5M investment?
comparison_set: Global urban drone delivery market size by year
preferred_sources: Industry association reports (e.g., Drone Industry Insights)
search_queries: urban drone delivery market size 2023 2024 2025 2026 2027 billion USD
global drone delivery market forecast annual revenue 2023-2027
FAA UAS market forecast 2023-2027
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use only publicly available market sizing reports from reputable sources. If exact values differ, note source and date. If only two endpoints available, apply CAGR and mark intermediate years as estimates.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Establishes the market opportunity size and growth trajectory to support the investment thesis.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: Before presenting market size, the report will state: 'To assess whether the market opportunity justifies the $45.5M budget, we first size the total addressable market for urban drone deliveries in top target cities.'
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: The exhibit shows a growing market, validating that the opportunity is substantial and growing, supporting the decision to proceed.
